testcase_source.revision_policy: A change to journey, receipt, runner, app source, effective lock, override, fixture contract or pinned goal requires a new candidate revision and fresh independent reviews.

build.verification: Record exact build command/toolchain and verify package, debug variant, version, ABI and APK digest before install. The digest is per-run evidence; source/lock/override/runner/testcase pins keep this testcase revision valid.

model.open_point: CHE-6839 permits no spend. A provider call can incur metered spend; the Android device squad leader must resolve this before any provider call.

firebase_debugview.prerequisite: Independent authorized Firebase DebugView fixture and access, recorded by the Android device squad leader.

store_sandbox_purchase.prerequisite: Independent store-sandbox fixture and access, recorded by the Android device squad leader. No purchase is fabricated and no money is spent.

fixture.onboarding: Approved clean first-run app fixture; capture visible UI state at every mapped step. Preserve pre-existing device data.
fixture.permission: Separate notification and microphone granted, denied, unavailable, suppressed and overlap scenarios; observe real OS dialog visibility. Do not issue a second request for telemetry.
fixture.speaking: Use an admitted deterministic session fixture; record accepted starts, ready results, terminal errors, recoveries, cancellations and retries as distinct outcomes.
fixture.flash_cards: Use a deterministic nonempty deck, empty deck and load-failure fixture; distinguish direct deck entry from shared intro-to-deck session.
fixture.ads: Use controlled display callbacks and confirm actual impression. Preload, failure, suppression and hidden route are not impressions.
fixture.paywall: Use loaded real weekly/yearly store offers and preserve source. No fabricated product IDs or purchase.
fixture.reset: Use only the approved app-level clean fixture for first-run cases. Return to each focused scenario through visible UI and record entry state. Do not broad-reset shared device state.
fixture.synchronization: Visible UI plus timestamped FA/FA-SVC capture. Event assertion requires exact event, allowed parameters, count and ordering in the complete observation window.

capture: device class, API, ABI and assigned serial
runner, testcase, app source, lock and override revisions
fresh fixture/reset and visible entry state
timestamped redacted FA and FA-SVC logs
per-event and per-removal result with exact count and parameters
first-run, clean-rerun and negative-control result when class qualification applies
evidence_contract.privacy: Never retain names, account identifiers, tokens, transcripts, audio, lesson/session IDs, URLs, purchase identifiers or credential values. Keep raw logs private; retain minimum redacted evidence.

exit_codes.0: All required native assertions complete and pass.
exit_codes.1: Completed native assertion failure, including the deliberate qualification control.
exit_codes.2: Incomplete, malformed, unchecked or inconclusive evidence; never PASS.

evidence_contract.unobserved_count: unknown; never infer zero from missing evidence

qualification.positive_pass: Clean representative testcase pass with complete artifacts.
qualification.clean_rerun: Repeat from the clean reset contract; preserve independent result and artifacts.
qualification.negative_control: Deliberately fail one assertion; native completed assertion exit must be 1 with the failure evidence retained.
qualification.cleanup_release: Preserve evidence, stop only run-owned processes, restore only changed settings, and obtain Android leader verification of device/lease release.
qualification.missing_or_uncertain_evidence: NOT-RUN or inconclusive; never qualify. Uncertain cleanup keeps target unavailable with named recovery owner.

goals.text: Run the CHE-6852 reviewed ST008 analytics testcase exactly as pinned. Use the clean first-run fixture, observe each visible onboarding step and Home, verify locale on entry, and classify fullscreen native only as deferred. Capture privacy-safe timestamped FA/FA-SVC evidence and fail closed on missing screens, wrong event names, parameters, counts, ordering or incomplete logs.

Exercise notification and microphone permissions in isolated scenarios and overlapping notification/microphone requests. Distinguish an actually displayed OS dialog from focus loss, pending native calls, bridge errors, existing grants, unsupported OS, suppressed requests and unavailable status. Verify safe speaking failure, no false notification telemetry and no extra prompt. Capture privacy-safe UI and complete timestamped FA/FA-SVC logs; fail closed on ambiguity.

Exercise speaking and flash-card accepted starts, real result-ready returns, terminal failures, recovery, empty/load failure, completion and explicit retry. Reconcile counts to real accepted attempts and real returns. Do not count cancellation, timers alone, empty decks, stale callbacks, recovered interruptions or duplicate callbacks as completion. Preserve assertion ledger and privacy-safe evidence; fail closed on count mismatch.

Exercise only deterministic ad and paywall paths. Confirm actual impressions, original source, real loaded store product IDs, accepted clicks and actual transitive SDK emissions. Keep Firebase DebugView and store-sandbox purchase NOT-RUN until their own authorized fixtures and access exist. Never fabricate an impression or purchase and never spend money.

Check every exact removed custom event family against complete actual SDK emission windows while preserving automatic Firebase collection. If the AVD class is unqualified, execute a clean representative pass, a clean rerun and a deliberate failed assertion with native exit 1. Preserve artifacts and have the Android leader verify cleanup and release. Missing logs or incomplete evidence are not an absence pass.

logic_review_findings.requirement: Focus loss during a pending native permission request does not count as a displayed prompt; observe the actual OS dialog.
logic_review_findings.failure_behavior: Fail the assertion or mark NOT-RUN if dialog visibility cannot be proven.

logic_review_findings.requirement: Overlapping notification/microphone requests and native bridge errors preserve safe speaking failure behavior and do not create false prompt events.
logic_review_findings.failure_behavior: Fail on unsafe speaking continuation, duplicate prompt event or ambiguous request result.

logic_review_findings.requirement: Notification status unavailable creates no false telemetry and no extra prompt.
logic_review_findings.failure_behavior: Fail on notification custom event or any additional OS prompt.

logic_review_findings.requirement: Speaking and flash-card real-return counts match the contract, including recovery, cancellation, retries, empty deck and duplicate callback cases.
logic_review_findings.failure_behavior: Fail on any count mismatch or false success/finish.

logic_review_findings.requirement: Inspect actual transitive SDK emissions because Git-source/hosted parity is unverified.
logic_review_findings.failure_behavior: Source-only review or app adapter logs cannot pass SDK emission coverage.
